title: Add an exception handler to Glide requests

timeline.message:
Add an exception handler to Glide requests

Fixes #26

timeline.body: To be sure that I don't accidentally use the method somewhere. It's basically undefined behavior, these things shouldn't be used in hash maps unless someone explicitly adds an implementation for the method in a subclass.

-

-/**
- * A callback interface used to perform some action when an {@link ImagePresenter} sets a new bitmap in an
- * {@link android.widget.ImageView}
- */
-public interface ImageReadyCallback {
-
-    /**
-     * The method called when a bitmap is set

-     * @param fromCache True iff the load completed without a placeholder being shown.
-     */
-    public void onImageReady(Target target, boolean fromCache);
-}

timeline.body:
@deathlord87 It's a bit confusing, but this is not a global error/result listener. Instead it's linked to the given target. So for a given image view, as long as the arguments to glide do not change, the handler passed in will handle exceptions/completions for any loads into that image view. 

Each request handler therefore may handle multiple loads, but there can be up to one handler per view/target.
